title: The Model Knows Better: Defending Medical Multi-Agent Systems Against Prompt Injection
abstract: arXiv:2610.22594v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Medical multi-agent systems, in which LLM agents discuss a case, are increasingly studied for clinical decision support. Prompt injection, text that an attacker adds to a model's input, can manipulate LLMs into wrong decisions. How it affects these systems, and how to protect them, remains unclear. Across two systems, two model families and three benchmarks, a single injected passage succeeds in up to 61% of cases, and collaboration does not consistently protect against it. Existing defenses help only partly: they miss injections that look like ordinary clinical text. Yet when asked to check the injected text against the patient's findings, a model that followed the injection usually rejects it. We therefore propose a training-free defense that verifies the clinical judgments behind the system's decision. translated_title: 模型更了解情况：防御医疗多智能体系统免受提示注入攻击
translated_abstract: 医疗多智能体系统——即由多个大语言模型智能体共同讨论病例的系统——在临床决策支持领域的应用研究日益增多。提示注入是指攻击者添加到模型输入中的文本，它可以操纵大语言模型做出错误决策。提示注入如何影响这类系统以及如何保护这些系统，目前仍不清楚。在两个系统、两个模型系列和三个基准测试上的实验表明，单段注入文本最多可在61%的案例中成功操纵系统，且智能体之间的协作并不能持续提供有效防护。现有防御手段只能起到部分作用：它们会漏掉那些看起来像普通临床文本的注入内容。然而，当被要求将注入文本与患者的实际检查发现进行核对时，之前因遵循注入内容而做出决策的模型通常会拒绝该注入文本。因此，我们提出了一种无需训练的防御方法，用于验证系统决策背后的临床判断。该方法遵循临床实践，将患者的检查发现与临床判断（如诊断、建议和指示等）分离开来……
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需训练的防御方法，通过将患者检查发现与临床判断分离，并验证系统决策背后的临床判断是否与患者实际情况相符，从而有效防御医疗多智能体系统中的提示注入攻击。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a training-free defense that separates patient findings from clinical judgments and verifies the clinical reasoning behind system decisions, effectively protecting medical multi-agent systems against prompt injection attacks.
